descriptions.value: Time-of-check time-of-use (toctou) race condition in Linux Kernel allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

assertions.title: Linux Kernel Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

references.name: Linux Kernel Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

title: Linux Kernel Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

descriptions.value: In multiple functions of face_status.h, there is a possible way to modify verified biometric enrollment data in shared memory due to a race condition. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with System execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
